hero.body: We got tired of elitist beauty and inflated prices. At trino. we curate trends and products so you can play, experiment and express yourself your way.
hero.note: No expert role: just come and try

craft.title: We curate, not copy.
craft.body: We choose by shape, texture and real use. Everything in the shop has a reason.

a.title: We look closer
a.body: We test textures and finishes before adding them to the catalog.

b.title: We think of you
b.body: We look for products you will actually use, not ones that gather dust.

c.title: We play at your pace
c.body: Try, compare and pick what feels like you.

principles.title: Five ideas that drive us
principles.description: They are not style rules. They shape how we choose, write and show up for you.

complice.title: Ally.
complice.body: We talk to you like someone who already gets beauty, without lecturing.

curiosa.title: Curious.
curiosa.body: We look for what is new, try it and share what works for each style.

atrevida.title: Bold.
atrevida.body: We cheer on color, shine and change. Try something different.

clara.title: Clear.
clara.body: We describe what you see and how it feels to use, without inflated words.

optimista.title: Upbeat.
optimista.body: Makeup can be a moment of play, not an obligation.

a.title: Pop and bold
a.body: Makeup to play with color, shine and texture.

b.title: Useful and within reach
b.body: A selection made for everyday use.

c.title: Close
c.body: We speak the way you do: simple, warm and straight to the point.

d.title: Curious
d.body: We try, compare and learn with every launch.

a.title: Elitist
a.body: No closed lists or codes only a few understand.

b.title: Dogmatic
b.body: There is no single right way to wear makeup.

c.title: Perfect
c.body: We are not chasing an ideal: we want you to feel at ease.

team.title: Made by people who pay attention
team.description: Behind every pick there is someone testing, reading and listening.
team.quote: Every pick should start with a question and end with a smile.
team.author: trino. team
team.tile1Body: Every image, text and detail page gets a careful review.
team.tile2Body: We bring in many perspectives so nobody feels left out.

cta.title: Make noise your way.
cta.body: Browse the shop and find something that invites you to try what is next.
cta.note: NO PERFECTION · NO RULES · WITH STYLE

club.title: Did you like what you read?
club.body: Keep this page and come back whenever you want to find your next pick.

stories.title: Stories to read at your pace
stories.description: Notes, ideas and finds from our world. Written by the team.
stories.emptyBody: Come back soon: the first stories are on their way.

hero.description: A place to keep what you like and come back when you are ready to decide.

toolbar.count: {count, plural, one {# saved item} other {# saved items}}

empty.title: Your list is waiting
empty.description: You have not saved anything yet. Browse the shop and tap the heart on what you like.

share.title: Your list, in one link
share.body: Copy this page link and send it to whoever you want.
share.highlight: No sign-in needed: just what you saved, in one place.

a.title: Kept for you
a.body: The list is tied to your session so you find it again.

b.title: Only yours
b.body: Each list belongs to one session and is shown only here.

c.title: No commitment
c.body: Remove a product whenever you want by tapping the heart.

d.title: Always clear
d.body: You see the reference of every product you saved.

notify.title: We will let you know when it is back
notify.body: This screen shows how the notice would look. We do not store emails or send messages here.
notify.note: Demo notice: no emails are sent.
